steps.content: The battle is over. The indistinct dark shadows have vanished. Horo's ghost is nowhere to be found.
But Zoya is still before you, grabbing onto an enemy's twisted body and swinging her fist over and over again.

steps.speaker: Teenage Zoya
steps.content: Die! Die!! Die, all of you!!

Up close, you notice that's not the Legion's commander's outfit. Not yet tall and broad, she has bandages all over her body. Her attacks are hysterical, but lack the unusual power—they're only immature punches from a teenager.
Only the furious urge to destroy is unchanged in sixteen-year-old Zoya, perhaps even more intense.
Her roars have grown husky and her fists are bloodied and raw. She is completely lost in rage.
I told you to stop! Don't get f***ing carried away!
A hand suddenly grabs her fist in the air, which makes the bloodthirsty Zoya even crankier. She turns back to glare angrily at the person stopping her, but is then stunned by who she sees.
It's a tall and broad middle-aged man in a sheriff's uniform.
She says the name in a daze. The surrounding mist begins flowing slowly, filling up your vision.
